population.long_horizon_5000_scope: hash-ranked contextual subset only; 20 streams per scenario

source_identity.distributional_generator_semantics: same 14-scenario family/regime/severity generator semantics as the frozen Phase 9/F08 synthetic design
source_identity.source_key: first 64 bits (16 lowercase hex) of SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 CONF source address
source_identity.materialisation_rule: F10 materialises each CONF source exactly once into separately hashed feature and label tapes before any method consumes it; all paired arms and contextual comparators assigned to that stream consume the same source bytes

optimizer_randomness.base_key: first 64 bits of SHA-256 over the exact UTF-8 base-key address
optimizer_randomness.treatment_rng: addressed substreams derived from the common base key plus treatment, checkpoint and semantic role; never a shared sequential RNG cursor

treatments.h3: E[L(MATERIAL-REPLACE)-L(STRUCTURAL-SHAM)|eligible] under the equal-scenario design-mixture checkpoint distribution
treatments.h3_itt_secondary: attempt(REPLACE)-attempt(SHAM), all forks with no-eligible as the frozen no-op zero contrast
treatments.positive_sign: favours retention/keeping the relevant fitted state or material
treatments.primary_outcome: mean prequential 0-1 loss over the next 2000 observations

stream_level_estimators.h1: arithmetic mean of the two checkpoint-specific 2000-row RESTART-CART minus PERSIST loss contrasts for the independent stream
stream_level_estimators.h2: arithmetic mean of the two checkpoint-specific 2000-row CHAMPION-RESEED minus PERSIST loss contrasts for the independent stream
stream_level_estimators.h3_components: for checkpoint c, e_ic is eligibility and d_ic is replace-minus-sham contrast when eligible; A_i=(e_i10000*d_i10000+e_i20000*d_i20000)/2; Q_i=(e_i10000+e_i20000)/2
stream_level_estimators.h3_estimator: [mean over equal-weight scenarios of stream-mean A_i] / [mean over equal-weight scenarios of stream-mean Q_i]
stream_level_estimators.h3_zero_observed_eligibility: NOT_ESTIMABLE; retain multiplicity slot with unadjusted p=1 and simultaneous interval [-1,1]
stream_level_estimators.h3_itt: equal-scenario mean of the stream-level average over both checkpoint attempt-policy contrasts, with no-eligible equal to zero

primary_inference.h1_h2_method: paired equal-scenario stratified symmetric absolute bootstrap-t over independent streams
primary_inference.h3_method: equal-scenario stratified stream-cluster ratio bootstrap-t over joint (A_i,Q_i) components
primary_inference.resampling_unit: whole independent stream within scenario; all nested checkpoint components travel together
primary_inference.multiplicity: Holm over the fixed three-hypothesis family; H3 non-estimability does not recycle alpha
primary_inference.simultaneous_intervals: Bonferroni marginal confidence level 0.9833333333333333 using absolute bootstrap-t critical values
primary_inference.bootstrap_absolute_pivot_critical_order_: 9834th one-based sorted absolute pivot under the frozen A2 tail convention
primary_inference.fallback: frozen conservative bounded-support reference for original zero-variance/non-estimable cases; infinite critical value yields [-1,1]

material_contract.site_selection: uniform addressed random selection among eligible maximal sites from pre-outcome identity only
material_contract.replacement_training: deterministic CART on past-only revealed recent rows reaching the selected site, bounded by original subtree depth and node count
material_contract.sham: same replacement-candidate construction cost but discard candidate and deploy a fresh-provenance literal copy of the old selected material; deployed semantic tree hash must equal parent

resource_contract.primary_budget_axis: APW deterministic adaptation-work accounting from F02/F05
resource_contract.h1_h2: equal total post-fork APW envelope; construction/reinitialisation charged
resource_contract.h3: same selected site and same replacement-candidate construction pipeline; independent arm ledgers
resource_contract.cpu_elapsed_rss_prediction_latency_state: reported separately and never relabelled as APW

failure_policy.source_or_integrity_failure: INFRASTRUCTURE_INVALID; no scientific record; versioned repair required before rerun
failure_policy.algorithm_failure_after_valid_start: retain full planned denominator; remaining prediction slots receive 0-1 loss 1
failure_policy.treatment_unavailable: apply the F05 treatment-unavailable full-denominator rule; no fallback treatment
failure_policy.parent_algorithmic_failure: does not automatically make RESTART-CART unavailable when valid revealed history still permits a genuine restart
failure_policy.no_eligible_material: scientific boundary condition; H3 primary ineligible and H3-ITT no-op zero

contextual_comparators.role: contextual predictive benchmark only; not H1-H3 identification and not primary multiplicity
contextual_comparators.selection: 20 smallest SHA-256 keys per scenario under DT-C8E1-F09-v1|CONF|COMPARATOR-SUBSET|stream=<source_key_hex>
contextual_comparators.profiles: exact F07 constructors; ROLLING_CART window 2000 and refit cadence 100
contextual_comparators.seed: first 32 bits of SHA-256 over DT-C8E1-F09-v1|CONF|COMPARATOR|method=<method>|stream=<source_key_hex>; EFDT explicitly unseeded

secondary_sensitivity.500_row_horizon: available for every primary fork as a prefix of the 2000-row execution
secondary_sensitivity.5000_row_horizon: only on the frozen 20-per-scenario hash-ranked contextual subset
secondary_sensitivity.random_restart_S1: only on the same 20-per-scenario subset at both checkpoints; secondary diagnostic, outside primary multiplicity
secondary_sensitivity.adaptive_repair_S2: NOT_ADMITTED_IN_F10; separate future decision layer, not allowed to alter the frozen material-identification core

mechanism_analysis.outcome: eligible checkpoint MATERIAL-REPLACE minus STRUCTURAL-SHAM 2000-row loss contrast
mechanism_analysis.model: additive linear model with scenario fixed effects and no interactions
mechanism_analysis.continuous_scaling: outcome-blind mean/SD standardisation from CONF predictor values
mechanism_analysis.zero_variance_predictor: retain as zero column and mark coefficient non-estimable; do not drop after viewing outcome
mechanism_analysis.uncertainty: secondary equal-scenario stream-cluster bootstrap; no causal-mediator interpretation

seed_schedule.f10_rule: generate schedule before source materialisation, verify exact SHA-256, persist expanded TSV as execution evidence

novelty_firewall.next_required_refresh: F14 before manuscript consolidation, then F19 before final submission

immutability.change_after_any_conf_feature_or_label_v: requires new protocol version and quarantine of the affected old attempt
